evidence: Release workflow builds and publishes binaries and packages using its CI token.
AUR job decodes the configured SSH key, validates it, writes known_hosts and publishes PKGBUILD.
Bug/feature report command explicitly submits user content and a machine ID to its own issue tracker; no automatic report submission.
Archive member names contain no traversal or absolute paths.
changes: Octet-stream curl POST is notable, moved from upload to post; exfiltration mappings removed and consumers updated.
Short HTTP path shape moved out of C2 into HTTP URL API-path; matcher and exclusions preserved.
Directory-glob loop moved out of infection into control-flow loop; effective scope preserved.
Text-tool/key-name proximity moved out of credential theft into environment secret-name; matchers and exclusions preserved.
SSH chmod matcher now requires the ssh executable token and chmod on its command line; excludes ssh-keyscan followed by local chmod.
Binary request-body option description no longer claims an external destination.

evidence: No build.rs, network client, process launcher or unexpected executable archive members.
Key derivation, commitments, nullifiers, note encryption and proof circuits implement the declared library domain.
Yanked registry status alone does not prove malware.
Sentry init wrapper installs beforeSendEvent callback.
Callback converts supplied exception and context data to configured OpenTelemetry spans and returns the original event.
No install lifecycle hook, arbitrary execution, direct network endpoint or credential-store access.

placement_support: New rules use existing admitted leaves; no directory split.
Loop directory cap: relocated serial addition matcher to arithmetic without changing matcher/scope/exclusions; updated its exact consumer.
POST directory cap: consolidated Java setDoOutput(true) exact matcher into existing Java/Kotlin matcher; Java composite type gate is unchanged.
ancestor_consumer_review: Added glob loops legitimately satisfy loop selectors; a standalone serial addition no longer does.
Removed POST-only evidence from upload selectors; binary-only consumers cannot match its shell scope.
Broad credential-access selectors no longer inherit neutral key-name proximity.

validation.sample_scan_requirement: Each primary archive and all members have zero suspicious or hostile traits after changes.
validation.limitations: Source-flow analysis reports bounded/unsupported constructs; judgement also uses manual code inspection.
validation.controls: Remote SSH chmod and octet POST positives; local chmod, JSON POST, explicit lists, long URLs, non-key variables and disabled output negatives. C2 poll and self-overwrite hostile detections preserved.
